---
title: "Memphis ED wait times"
format: dashboard

---


```{python}
import boto3, gzip, json, io
from datetime import date, timedelta
import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px

BUCKET = "mem-ed-wait-times"
DAYS = 7
s3 = boto3.client("s3")

def _keys(prefix):
    pages = s3.get_paginator("list_objects_v2").paginate(Bucket=BUCKET, Prefix=prefix)
    return [o["Key"] for p in pages for o in p.get("Contents", [])]

def _records(key):
    body = s3.get_object(Bucket=BUCKET, Key=key)["Body"].read()
    if key.endswith(".gz"):
        body = gzip.decompress(body)
    return [json.loads(l) for l in body.decode("utf-8").splitlines() if l.strip()]

def load(days=DAYS):
    rows = []
    for i in range(days):
        d = (date.today() - timedelta(days=i)).isoformat()
        keys = _keys(f"compacted/ed_wait/dt={d}/") or _keys(f"raw/ed_wait/dt={d}/")
        for k in keys:
            rows.extend(_records(k))

    df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    df["observed_at"] = pd.to_datetime(df["observed_at"], utc=True).dt.tz_convert("America/Chicago")
    df["wait_minutes"] = pd.to_numeric(df["wait_minutes"], errors="coerce")
    return df.sort_values("observed_at")

df = load()
latest = df.groupby("facility", as_index=False).last()

```


## Row
```{python}
wait_fig = px.line(df, x="observed_at", y = "wait_minutes", color="facility", template="simple_white")

wait_fig.update_layout(
    legend=dict(
        orientation="h",
        yanchor="top", y=-0.2,
        xanchor="left", x=0,
        entrywidth=0.2, entrywidthmode="fraction",
    ),
    margin=dict(l=40, r=20, t=30, b=140),
)
```
